```plato

    //==
    // # Signed distance primitives
    //
    // Closed-form distance functions for primitives centred at the origin, after
    // Inigo Quilez: https://iquilezles.org/articles/distfunctions/
    //
    // Deliberately array-free, lambda-free, and free of function-valued fields:
    // only scalar and fixed-arity vector arithmetic over Point2D/Point3D and
    // Vector2D/Vector3D, plus `var` locals, which every target dialect has. That
    // is what lets these bodies port to GLSL, C++, and CUDA unchanged. Keep it
    // that way - build compositions with the combinators in
    // `fields-implicits.library.plato`, never inside these bodies.

    // The signed distance from a point to a sphere of the given radius centred at
    // the origin. Exact. (IQ: sdSphere.)
    DistanceToSphere(p: Point3D, radius: Number): Number
        => p.PositionVector.Magnitude - radius;
```
